name: Treshala Fallowbrook
summary: In Darnassus, Treshala Fallowbrook waits at home for news of her husband. Heralath Fallowbrook has gone far away, into Razorfen Kraul in the Barrens.

sections.title: A Watcher on the Terrace
sections.body: On the second floor of a Tradesmen's Terrace workshop, Treshala Fallowbrook waits for word from her husband. Heralath journeyed to Razorfen Kraul in the Barrens, where thorny growth surrounds the quilboar's warrens. Their marriage is marked by a pendant of bonding, which Heralath carried with him.

faq.q: Where can I find Treshala Fallowbrook?
faq.answer: Treshala Fallowbrook is on the second floor of a workshop in Darnassus's Tradesmen's Terrace. Climb the wooden ramp inside the weapons building to reach her room.
Treshala is not a researcher. Her husband, Heralath Fallowbrook, went to Razorfen Kraul, and she waits in Darnassus for news of him and the pendant of bonding he carried there.

faq.q: Why is she concerned with Razorfen Kraul?
faq.answer: Treshala is concerned because her husband, Heralath, ventured into Razorfen Kraul, a thorny quilboar stronghold in the Barrens, and she has had no word of him since.

faq.q: Is she a shopkeeper or a craftswoman?
faq.answer: Treshala is neither a merchant nor a crafter. She makes her home above the artisan stalls of the Tradesmen's Terrace.

angles.text: As a night elf, Treshala's quiet vigil for her husband recalls that since Mount Hyjal, her people no longer have eternity to wait.
As an Alliance champion, you may return to Darnassus after expeditions against the quilboar thorn-dens deep in the Barrens. Treshala is there.
